title: Open Grounded Planning: Challenges and Benchmark Construction
findings: The paper includes a 'Philosophy and Religion' category from the wikiHow dataset as part of its comprehensive Open Grounded Planning benchmark. However, it does not report or analyze the performance of the tested models specifically on this category; results are aggregated across the entire in-domain (wikiHow) dataset.
